overview.description: Apples is a four-player trick-taking game with bidding, a chosen trump suit, target cards, and scoring from pairs, triples, and four-of-a-kind groups won in tricks.

history.origins: Apples is documented as a modern standard-deck trick game related in feel to Hearts, Spades, and Bridge, but with its own bid pile and set-scoring system.
timeline: Modern era: Apples is described as a distinct four-player trick-taking game using a standard pack.
history.cultural: Apples is included because it has a distinct play system rather than being only a title or expansion page.

nullReasons.evolution: No detailed evolution chain is documented beyond the described form and listed variants.

setup.players: Four players each receive thirteen cards before bidding.
setup.deck: Use one standard 52-card deck, ranking ace high.
setup.equipment: Standard 52-card deck, score area, and enough table space for play.
setup.dealing: Deal all cards clockwise, then run bidding to set trump and exchange cards through the bidding pile before each player sets a target card aside.

rules.objective: Reach 250 points before the other players by winning scoring sets in tricks and matching the selected target card.
rules.gameplay: Players bid a number and suit to establish trump. The winning bidder contributes that many trump cards to a shuffled bidding pile, others contribute the same count, and cards are redealt. Each player sets aside a target card, then twelve tricks are played with follow-suit rules and trump. Won cards score only when they form pairs, triples, or four-of-a-kinds.
keyRules: Bidding chooses trump and creates a shuffled bidding pile.
Each player sets one target card aside before play.
Pairs, triples, and four-of-a-kinds in won tricks score toward 250.

strategy.basic: Bid only in suits with enough depth, and choose a target card that can realistically form a high-value triple or four-of-a-kind.

play_card.description: Play one card to the current trick.
play_card.constraints: Must follow suit if able. Otherwise, any card. Joker in No Trumps subject to nomination rules.

discard.description: Choose 3 cards from hand to discard face-down (never revealed).
discard.constraints: High bidder only. Must discard exactly 3 after taking kitty.

pass.description: Decline to bid. Player is out of the bidding for this hand.
pass.constraints: May pass on first turn or after hearing a higher bid.

bid.description: Bid the number of tricks (6-10) you believe your partnership will win. Optionally name trump or pass to No Trump declaration.
bid.constraints: Bid must be higher than previous highest bid. Once a player passes, they cannot rebid.

go_out.reason: Game has no going out mechanic.

engine.deckDescription: Deck used for Apples: Standard 52-card deck. Use the ranks, suits, special cards, and pack size described in the setup section for this catalog record.
engine.suitDescription: French suits: hearts (cœurs), diamonds (carreaux), clubs (trèfles), and spades (piques). Each suit has eight cards in the 32-card pack.
engine.rankDescription: Stripped 32-card ranking: each suit has eight cards from 7 (low) up through 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, King, and Ace high.
engine.dealPattern: 3 to each player and kitty, 4 to each player
